prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


SUBJECT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
Draw ONLY the actual CHONGFA TEMPLE PAGODA 崇法寺塔 in Yongcheng, Henan, Northern Song1098, from photo2. OCTAGONAL NINE-STOREY brick pagoda, with exactly NINE prominent roof-eave tiers, one per storey; retain between-storey projecting balconies with simple railings as seen. These balcony bands are NOT extra roof levels. The lowest storey is taller and has a pointed central arch doorway and small side lattice panels. Upper storeys have small pointed openings, brick imitations of columns and simple repeated bracket groups. Preserve the slim stepped taper and distinctive tall metal finial with stacked open circular rings, top canopy, slender mast and four diagonal tie-chains. The chains belong to the historic finial: keep them as thin single lines. Strip all masonry patterns and most repetitive ornament: only 2-3 contours per eave, a few bracket symbols per visible face, sparse outlines for windows and railings. All walls and openings white, no black fill. Keep one broad front face and adjacent narrow faces to show octagonal plan. Remove trees, two separate roofed stele boxes, railings around base, lanterns, modern plaques and neighboring temples. Full tower apex to simple plinth, vertical, portrait1024x1536, 12percent blank margins.

historical_sources.title: 中国华夏文化遗产基金会：崇法寺塔
凤凰网文保访谈：崇法寺塔护中州
historical_sources.supports: 塔内石匣记建造、后世修缮。该页1093与绍圣元年换算矛盾，未用来确定始建年。

historical_sources.title: 崇法寺塔护中州：融会南北造塔艺术
historical_sources.publisher: 中国新闻网（李双军，2013-04-26；凤凰网佛教转载）
historical_sources.note: 八角楼阁式9层砖塔、高34.6米、底层直径7.7米、第一层高5米；地宫塔基塔身塔刹四部分；每层檐下仰莲、四门、角饰石龙头系铁铃；塔刹覆钵相轮伞盖宝瓶、铁链系顶；黄绿釉佛像砖651块；塔铭5块刻于绍圣二年（1095）；石匣记建塔始末；80年代维修清理地宫出宋铜钱；穿心式/回廊式/壁内折上式；李俊山南北融合说；“宝塔盘云”。原文误将1093年写作绍圣元年，未采

historical_sources.title: 崇法寺塔
historical_sources.note: 维基百科，二手来源（引凤凰网/中新网2013）；始建于宋元祐八年（1093）、建成于绍圣五年（1098）；全高34.6米、底部直径7.7米；50年代与80年代两次修缮

site_recommendation.name: 崇法寺塔
site_recommendation.sub: 层层平座与莲瓣托起的宋塔
site_recommendation.yearNote: 按塔竣工年1098；建地宫1093、起塔身1095见基金会资料，部分二手来源误把1093写作绍圣元年，未采此错误换算。
site_recommendation.lede: 崇法寺塔在永城老城中层层升起。八角九层的砖塔模仿木构楼阁，以密集出檐与平座勾出宋代塔身的节奏。

facts.label: 宋代塔身
facts.text: 塔于北宋绍圣五年（1098）竣工，寺院沿革早于这座现存塔。

facts.label: 八角九层
facts.text: 塔高34.6米，各层具有出檐、平座和门窗；檐与平座分别计数，塔身为九层。

facts.label: 砖作仿木
facts.text: 塔以砖作表现柱、斗栱和栏杆，塔内还保存琉璃佛像砖等构件，后世曾修缮。
